name: run_sql_query
description: Execute a SQL query on a Perfetto trace to retrieve information in JSON format. The trace is loaded automatically if needed. Use trace_path to load from a specific file path, or session_id to load from the traces directory. If both are omitted, uses the most recently captured trace.

query.description: SQL query to execute against the trace

session_id.description: The file name of the trace (session ID). If omitted, uses the most recently captured trace. Ignored if trace_path is provided.

trace_path.description: Full path to a .pftrace or .ptrace file. If provided, uses this exact path instead of looking in the traces directory.
